#include <iostream>
#include <queue>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;

class FastReader {
public:
    string next() {
        string str;
        cin >> str;
        return str;
    }

    string nextLine() {
        string str;
        getline(cin, str);
        return str;
    }

    int ni() {
        return stoi(next());
    }

    long nl() {
        return stol(next());
    }

    double nd() {
        return stod(next());
    }

    vector<int> ia(int N) {
        vector<int> a(N);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            a[i] = ni();
        }
        return a;
    }

    vector<long> la(int N) {
        vector<long> a(N);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            a[i] = nl();
        }
        return a;
    }
};

int main() {
    FastReader in;
    int n = in.ni();
    int B = in.ni();
    vector<int> arr = in.ia(n);
    priority_queue<int> pq;
    int e = 0;
    int o = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        int ele = arr[i];
        if (ele % 2 == 0) e++;
        else o++;
        if (e == o) {
            pq.push(abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]));
        }
    }
    long ans = 0;
    while (B >= 0 && !pq.empty()) {
        B -= pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        if (B < 0) break;
        ans++;
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
